reply.emotion: joyful and carefree, moving to the beat with a bright smile
notes: Use danser when moving your body to music or at a party.
Do not confuse it with faire de la danse, which specifically refers to taking dance classes or practicing it as an art form.

senses.definition: To move your body to the rhythm of music.

examples.text: Ils aiment danser toute la nuit en écoutant de la musique pop.
examples.translation: They like to dance all night listening to pop music.
examples.emotion: excited and energetic, talking about a fun night out

definitions: To move your body to the rhythm of music.
